description: This file contains utility structures and functions for managing and checking the environment related to a Gateway component in a larger software project. It includes version handling (Semver), environment status checks, command resolution, and installation procedures for the openclaw gateway and CLI tools.

classes.name: Semver
classes.description: A lightweight implementation of semantic versioning (major.minor.patch) with parsing, comparison, and compatibility check functionalities.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a version string into a Semver object, handling optional 'v' prefix and prerelease suffixes.

methods.name: compatible(with:)
methods.description: Checks if the current Semver object is compatible with the required version based on major version equality and whether it is not older.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs environment checks to determine the status of the gateway and node versions, returning a GatewayEnvironmentStatus.

methods.name: resolveGatewayCommand
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the command to run the gateway, considering environment state, configuration, and version compatibility.

methods.name: installGlobal
methods.description: Installs the openclaw CLI globally via npm, pnpm, or bun, with status updates and handling of output.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayVersionOutput
methods.description: Normalizes the output string from gateway version commands to facilitate parsing.

methods.name: readGatewayVersion
methods.description: Executes the gateway binary with '--version' to extract its version information as a Semver.

methods.name: readLocalGatewayVersion
methods.description: Reads the version of the gateway from the local 'package.json' file in the project root.
